rows.note: This is the all-purpose verb for surrounding something, including figurative cases and situations where escape is blocked.

example.english: The police surround the suspect, leaving them nowhere to go.
example.traditional: 警察包圍咗疑犯，佢冇路走。
example.jyutping: ging2 caat3 baau1 wai4 zo2 ji4 faan6 keoi5 mou5 lou6 zau2

rows.note: Use this colloquial form when people or things physically close in around something, especially to keep it from getting away.

example.english: The dogs surround the thief, so he cannot get away.
example.traditional: 啲狗圍住個小偷，搞到佢走唔甩。
example.jyutping: di1 gau2 wai4 zyu6 go3 siu2 tau1 gaau2 dou3 keoi5 zau2 m4 lat1
